A hidden article still opens at its address in every language for anyone with the link, but says noindex and leaves every list, tag page, feed, the sitemap and llms.txt. GitHub Pages cannot redirect, so this site only hides. Titles are reminders only; ids decide. Take an entry out to bring the article back.
